conviction_note: The FY2027 guide was withheld in July because of the Middle East. A coatings peer resumed its guide at its own Q1 and the paint association declared supply stable, so a first guide plus a dividend forecast is more likely than not tonight. That is the one positive. The negatives are mechanical: guided ordinary profit will probably fall against FY26's one-off-inflated 945m, and the Q1 comp is the strongest Q1 in three years. Net about -0.5 on the findings. The scaled number is near 0 because the sign is a coin flip, but a big move is likely: Q1 prints moved this name -9.3% and +15.4% in the last two years, it trades only ~JPY16.5m a day, and there may be a first guide.
bar: No company forecast exists (FY2027.05 is 未定, https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260713/140120260713591882.pdf) and no IFIS/四季報 number was reachable, so the only bar is the prior-year Q1: sales 1,097m, OP 124m, ordinary 134m (https://kabutan.jp/stock/news?code=1401&b=k202510140097). Not a company guide and not two agreeing estimates, so every size is capped small.
positioning_check: JPX disclosed short register: 0.0% with no change (as of 2026-09-29, https://www.jpx.co.jp/markets/public/short-selling/index.html). The name is 制度信用 buy-only (kabutan: 買建のみ), so there are no margin shorts and no squeeze fuel. Margin longs were 79,200 shares on 2026-07-17 (https://irbank.net/1401/margin), about 1.1% of shares outstanding excluding treasury stock; later weeks are not visible. There is no skew, as Japan has no option market. The 20d run-up of +12.9% came from a theme rally (TV feature, Murata RFID) that peaked at 1,775 on 10-05 and fell 13.5% that day on 154k shares; the 5d run-up is -0.9%.

findings.finding: The FY2027 forecast and dividend were left 未定 on 2026-07-13 because of naphtha-derived material supply and cost risk tied to the Middle East. The same uncertainty has since eased: the 日本塗料工業会 ended its special supply reporting on 2026-08-17 ('状況が安定に向かって'), and exterior-coatings maker 菊水化学工業 resumed full-year guidance at its Q1 on 2026-08-07 with OP up 74%. A first FY27 guide and dividend forecast with this Q1 is therefore more likely than not. Against that, MBS held its COVID-era 未定 through Q1 and Q2 and published only at Q3 (2021-04-13).
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The FY print on 2026-07-13 with no guide fell 4.1% the next session (1,356 to 1,301, Yahoo bars). The July 2025 print with a +11.8% OP guide rose ('連続最高益予想で買い安心感', kabutan 2025-07-15).
findings.why_not_priced: Without a guide, kabutan shows PER and yield as '－' and there is no forecast for a screen to pick up. The stock's recent moves are theme-driven (TV feature, Murata), not earnings-driven. If resumption were expected and priced, the stock would not have given back most of the theme rally in the week before the print (1,735 to 1,449).
findings.independence: Two independent documents point the same way: the 菊水化学 resumption notice https://www2.jpx.co.jp/disc/79530/140120260806513326.pdf (2026-08-07) and the 日本塗料工業会 notice https://www.toryo.or.jp/jp/anzen/news/files/ME-20260817.pdf (2026-08-17). The counter-precedent is MBS's own 2021-04-13 notice https://www.fse.or.jp/files/lis_tkj/21041314010.pdf.

findings.finding: FY26 ordinary profit of 945m included about 203m of one-offs: insurance-surrender gain 127m, foreign-bond redemption gain 54m and bond interest 22m. Normal non-operating income is +30-46m (FY24, FY25). Any FY27 guide therefore probably shows ordinary profit DOWN year on year even if OP grows, and kabutan headlines lead with 経常.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No prior instance of a guided ordinary-profit decline found for this name. Its guided-growth prints (July 2025) were bought.
findings.why_not_priced: It only exists if a guide is issued tonight, and the one-off split sits in the 短信 narrative rather than in any screen. The kabutan FY table shows 945 as a record without the breakdown.
findings.independence: Same document as the first finding; this is conditional on that finding and partly offsets it. No independent source.

findings.finding: Q1 faces the strongest Q1 comp in three years: Jun-Aug 2025 OP was 124m at an 11.3% margin, against 50m in 2024 and 116m in 2023. Q4 FY26 margin had already slipped from 14.7% to 12.3% under the naphtha cost spike, and naphtha prices rose again in July 2026. Advance receipts (未成工事受入金, +128m) and Q4 sales of +20% year on year argue that sales hold up.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q1 is this name's biggest mover. The weak Q1 on 2024-10-15 (OP 50m) fell 9.3% the next day (774 to 702). The strong Q1 on 2025-10-14 (OP 2.5x) rose 15.4% (1,223 to 1,411). The beats at Q2 and Q3 FY26 were sold (-2.4%, -2.1%).
findings.why_not_priced: Partly priced: the comp is public and anyone can compute it. The cost read is inference from Q4 margin and industry series, not a company number, which is why it is sized small. The market has no Q1 bar because no plan exists.
findings.independence: The Q4 margin compression is in https://kabutan.jp/stock/news?code=1401&b=k202607130040 (2026-07-13). The industry cost pressure is in the 日本塗料工業会 2026-08-17 notice, but that notice also says supply normalised, which cuts the other way.

findings.finding: The 20-day run-up is a theme rally, not an earnings run-in. The stock went 1,311 to 1,775 on the 'ガイアの夜明け' infrastructure feature (aired 10-02), then fell 13.5% on 154k shares on 10-05 (about ten times normal volume). Retail that bought the theme is exposed to a fundamentals print, and this name sold its last two beats.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q2 FY26 beat: -2.4%. Q3 FY26 beat: -2.1%. FY26 print with no guide: -4.1%.
findings.why_not_priced: Largely priced. The 13.5% give-back on 10-05 already flushed much of it, the 5d run-up is -0.9%, and the baseline lean (-0.65) already carries the run-up. That is why the size is minimal.
findings.independence: The tape (Yahoo daily bars) shows the same theme run: https://query1.finance.yahoo.com/v8/finance/chart/1401.T?range=2y&interval=1d

outside_window.finding: Precedent for a buyback right after Q1. On 2025-10-16 (18:00, two days after the Q1 print) MBS announced a buyback and the stock rose; a July 2025 buyback came four days after the FY print. Cash is 2.42bn against a 11.5bn market cap and treasury stock is 800k shares. If the pattern repeats it lands after the 10-14 close.

No IFIS or 四季報 FY27 estimate was reachable; kabutan shows '－' for the forecast and the quarterly table is premium
No 業績予想の修正 or 配当予想 filed for 1401 since 2026-07-13 (kabutan disclosure list through 2026-10-13)
No disclosure since 2026-08-31 besides news items; the 2026-08-28 事業計画及び成長可能性 omits FY27 targets ('不確定要素が多い') and says nothing on Q1
Margin balance after 2026-07-17: irbank free tier stops there, and the kabutan margin page is behind a CAPTCHA
release_time_source: https://kabutan.jp/stock/news?code=1401&b=k202607130040 (FY print stamped 7月13日大引け後(16:00); Q1 2025-10-14, Q2 2026-01-14 and Q3 2026-04-13 also 16:00)
bar_hierarchy: Forecast: none exists (未定); a first FY27 guide plus dividend is possible tonight and more likely than not on peer precedent, but the company's COVID precedent waited until Q3. Returns: the dividend forecast is 未定 (streak 6, 8, 13, 15 yen) and arrives only with a guide; the buyback precedent lands two days after Q1, outside the window. New-year guide: this IS the first-guide event if it comes. Quarter: no plan, so no 進捗率; the comp is the prior-year Q1 (OP 124m, the strongest of three years).

rejected_candidates.candidate: The largest-ever order (Ohno Kaihatsu drydock, works Feb 2026 to Jan 2027) supports Q1 sales
rejected_candidates.detail: The same notice states '業績に与える影響は軽微', so it cannot carry a sales finding.

rejected_candidates.candidate: Buyback announced with or right after Q1, as in October 2025
rejected_candidates.detail: The 2025 precedent came two days after the print (10-16), after the 10-14 exit; it is filed in outside_window.

baseline_tension: The findings lean slightly negative, agreeing with the -0.65 run-up lean. The strongest positive the release could carry is a first FY27 guide plus a dividend forecast (likely 15 yen or more given the streak), which I looked for and filed as the one positive finding. A buyback is the other, but on precedent it falls outside the window. A crowded short cannot squeeze because the name is buy-only on margin.
lessons_applied: Rule 1: the Q1-comp negative rests on a public prior-year number anyone can compute, so it was cut from -0.8 to -0.6 and p_up moved from 48 to 49.

Open question 4 (run-in as a short signal, which was wrong once): the theme-crowd positioning finding was cut from -0.4 to -0.2, since the 5d run-up is already negative and the give-back has happened.

Rule 2: three negatives against one positive, so the strongest positives (a first guide plus dividend, and a buyback) were written into baseline_tension. Both had been searched; the buyback stays outside the window. The positive finding is unchanged at +0.6.
The ordinary-profit-headline finding (-0.3) is left standing: it is conditional arithmetic from the company's own document, not a visible miss.
